description: Perpetual futures funding rates for up to 10 coins across Binance, Bybit, OKX and Hyperliquid in one call: funding rate per interval, interval hours, annualized APR, mark price, open interest in USD and next funding time per venue, plus average APR, total open interest, max/min venue and the funding spread as an arbitrage hint. Venues that are unreachable or do not list a coin are reported per venue. Params: coins (default BTC, ETH, SOL), venues (default all). Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"coins":["BTC","ETH","SOL"]}.
